subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should this issue remain the canonical live macOS service-context Claude CLI OAuth 401 investigation until a maintainer can compare managed gateway execution against same-environment Claude CLI replay with live MCP enabled?
rationale: The code path and user logs are strong, but the remaining choice between OpenClaw runtime bug, Claude CLI/keychain setup boundary, MCP interaction, or narrower recovery-copy work depends on live provider/keychain proof that ClawSweeper cannot safely infer from source alone.

options.title: Keep As Live-Repro Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open and use it to drive a maintainer-owned live macOS LaunchAgent or equivalent service-context repro before changing auth isolation or closing as setup.

options.title: Fold Into Recovery-Copy Work
options.body: Treat the open Claude CLI OAuth 401 PR cluster as sufficient only if maintainers decide better re-auth guidance is the whole remaining product need.

options.title: Close As External Setup After Reporter Confirmation
options.body: Close only if the reporter confirms the same GUI-session Claude re-authentication resolution seen in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95367 fixes this environment too.

recommendation.title: Keep As Live-Repro Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use it to drive a maintainer-owned live macOS LaunchAgent or equivalent service-context repro before changing auth isolation or closing as setup.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history signal across CLI runner, ring-zero MCP, and Anthropic CLI defaults that would frame the live repro and fix boundary.
